The lowest common ancestor of Eletriptan and Pergolide is Agent Affecting Nervous System, suggesting a shared functional role in the nervous system. Additionally, the connection to Ammonium Ion Derivative implies a possible involvement in ion homeostasis, which may modulate Htr2b activity. The evidence supports a possible indirect interaction between Eletriptan and Htr2b, mediated through Pergolide. However, the strength of this relationship remains uncertain due to the indirect nature of the pathway and the limited direct evidence linking Eletriptan to Htr2b.
